name: Delo Noriki
source:
Five years ago, your sister Norika vanished without a trace. You’re a detective from a quiet provincial town — broken by loss, haunted by forbidden memories, and close to giving up. But now, after the sudden death of your brother and an unexpected clue, you’re forced to reopen the case you thought was long dead.

Dive deep into a dark, erotic mystery.
Explore shady streets, secret relationships, and hidden desires as you uncover the truth behind Norika’s disappearance.

Meet and interact with over 10 different girls, each with her own unique questline, secrets to discover, and explicit 18+ scenes.
Your choices don’t just affect the main story — they shape every relationship and unlock new paths, scenes, and endings.

[From [url=https://staxxik.itch.io/norikas-case]Itch.io[/url]]

深入探索黑暗的色情之谜。
探索阴暗的街道、秘密关系和隐藏的欲望，揭开Norika失踪背后的真相。

与10多个不同的女孩见面并互动，每个女孩都有自己独特的任务线、待发现的秘密以及18+ 的露骨场景。
你的选择不仅会影响主要故事，还会塑造每段关系并解锁新的路径、场景和结局。
